name: Parimere
title: Parimere unit price comparison: pack sizes, discounts and budgets
description: Compare unit prices and purchase costs across different pack sizes and offers.

sections.heading: How do I compare two packs?
paragraphs: Enter each price, pack size and quantity using compatible units. For example, compare a 500 g pack costing 4 with a 750 g pack costing 5 in the same currency. Their unit prices are 8 and about 6.67 per kilogram before extra costs.

sections.heading: What affects the result?
paragraphs: Discounts, shipping, taxes, fees, waste and prepared yield can change the comparison. Choose the ranking and planning settings that match the purchase.

sections.heading: How is the starting currency selected?
paragraphs: The web app uses the browser region when supported and otherwise defaults to USD. You can change it. Saved comparisons keep their original currencies.

sections.heading: Are the web and mobile apps identical?
paragraphs: No. The mobile app supports manually entered prices and exchange rates, saved comparisons and reviewed file import/export. Receipt scanning, household sync and automatic exchange rates are not implemented in the current React Native mobile version.

sections.heading: Where is information stored?
paragraphs: Calculations run locally. Web household sharing is optional and requires a configured server. Shared files leave the app only when you choose to share them.
